description: José Andrés founded World Central Kitchen after the 2010 Haiti earthquake, prioritizing dignity and memory through food. WCK has since become a global relief machine, serving over 600 million meals by acting as 'first to the frontlines' and working with local communities.
title: Chef cooks for disaster victims worldwide and his kitchen is what the world needs

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Virat Kohli is on the cusp of a historic T20 milestone, needing just 20 runs to become the first batter to score 1,000 runs against Mumbai Indians. He already holds the record for most T20 runs against MI, with 980 in 35 innings. This achievement adds another layer to his dominance against top teams.
title: IPL: Virat Kohli on brink of history, poised to become 1st batter to...

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Yann LeCun, Meta's former chief AI scientist and deep learning pioneer, has dismissed the panic around Anthropic's Claude Mythos Preview as "BS from self-delusion." While the model's reported ability to find vulnerabilities in every major operating system and browser spooked Wall Street and triggered an emergency Fed meeting, LeCun and other AI researchers argue the threat is overhyped—though cybersecurity firms using Mythos disagree.
title: Meta's most-popular former employee and father of AI calls Anthropic's latest model as 'drama'

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: KKR have had a difficult start to the season, with three defeats and one match ending without a result. Their issues have been clear in the death overs, where they have struggled to control opposition batters. Losses to Mumbai Indians and Lucknow Super Giants highlighted these concerns, making Pathirana’s return important.
title: KKR's Pathirana clears fitness test, likely to join squad ahead of CSK clash

author: RATNAKAR MANNE
description: Shuttler Sets Up BAC Summit Clash With Reigning World Champion Shi Yu Qi
title: Ayush Shetty to play China's Shi in Badminton Asia Championships final

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is urging people to stay in California, despite its high taxes. Speaking at Stanford, he declared, 'Move to California. Don’t leave. It’s the highest taxes in the world, but it’s OK.' Huang, a billionaire himself, expressed contentment with potential new taxes, emphasizing his embrace of Silicon Valley living.
title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang does not agree with billionaires leaving California

author: AADYA JHA
description: Your body often speaks in quiet tones—fatigue and bloating can hint at an underlying immune imbalance that starts in the gut. When the gut's defense system falters, it may mislead the immune response, paving the way for inflammation and even autoimmune disorders. Recognizing these early signs, which are frequently brushed aside, can be vital for prompt diagnosis and effective treatment.
title: Autoimmune diseases may start in gut: Early signs and what you can do to restore balance

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: Global crude oil markets are in a frenzy as a severe shortage drives intense competition for prompt deliveries. Physical oil prices have surged to unprecedented levels, with buyers vastly outnumbering sellers. This scramble, fueled by reduced Middle Eastern flows, is forcing refiners to consider scaling back operations, potentially worsening fuel shortages.
title: Strait crisis: Global traders race to secure oil barrels amid Hormuz supply crunch

author: TOI NEWS DESK
description: Indian fishermen, stranded in Iran due to escalating Middle East conflict, expressed profound gratitude for their safe return facilitated by coordinated diplomatic efforts. Union Minister Piyush Goyal received the first batch of 345 fishermen at Chennai Airport, highlighting Prime Minister Modi's directive for their evacuation from Iran via Armenia.
title: 'Provided great assistance to get us out': Indian fishermen stranded in Iran return home

author: PRIYANKA KAKODKAR
description: A senior bureaucrat, Manisha Patankar Mhaiskar, revealed a minister in the Mahayuti government blocked her appointment to head a department in 2023, citing her gender. This incident, occurring during her 33-year career, has sparked debate, especially given the government's stated commitment to women's empowerment and leadership roles.
title: Mahayuti minister didn’t want a woman to head dept & I was bypassed: Maharashtra official

author: TOI NEWS DESK
description: A magnitude 4.3 earthquake jolted Assam on Sunday morning at 09:21:58 IST. The tremor, originating at a depth of 5 km in Cachar district, had its epicentre at latitude 24.659°N and longitude 92.763°E. No immediate damage or casualties have been reported.
title: Assam earthquake: Magnitude 4.3 tremor hits Cachar district

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Lebanon's Prime Minister Nawaf Salam has postponed his US and UN visit due to "current internal circumstances" and security concerns. This comes amid rising tensions, with Iran warning Beirut against sidelining Hezbollah in talks with Israel. Israeli strikes continue, complicating regional stability efforts despite a ceasefire push.
title: 'To preserve security of people': Lebanon PM postpones US visit amid Israeli strikes

author: SANDEEP RAGHAVAN
description: A 19-year-old accused in a minor girl's murder attempted to flee while being transferred by police. He attacked officers with a rod, injuring two constables. Police fired shots below his knees to subdue him, ensuring his apprehension and promising justice for the victim's family.
title: 19-year-old spurned man who 'killed' Andhra Pradesh girl tries to flee, shot in leg

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: US-Iran nuclear talks in Islamabad concluded without a deal after 21 hours, with deep divisions over nuclear commitments, sanctions relief, and regional control preventing a breakthrough. Both sides indicated future discussions, but significant disagreements over enrichment, frozen assets, and maritime security remain.
title: US-Iran talks pause without breakthrough: 5 reasons why negotiations failed in Pakistan

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Legendary singer Asha Bhosle has been admitted to Breach Candy Hospital. She is undergoing treatment after suffering a cardiac arrest. Her granddaughter confirmed the hospitalization due to exhaustion and chest infection. The 92-year-old artist has a long and celebrated career in playback singing. Fans and the music fraternity are concerned. Updates on her health are awaited.
title: Asha Bhosle's 'aaja aaja main hoon pyar tera' story: Singer recalls funny practice moment

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Amazon's Project Houdini initiative aims to significantly reduce data center construction times for AI development. By shifting assembly of server rooms and other key components to factories, the tech giant expects to cut months from build timelines and tens of thousands of labor hours. This modular approach will enable faster deployment of computing capacity to meet surging AI demand.
title: Amazon plans to do an 'impossible' in data centers with its 'Project Houdini'

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: High-stakes talks between Iran and the US in Islamabad concluded without an agreement, with Tehran accusing Washington of "breaches of promise" and "excessive demands." Key issues like the Strait of Hormuz and Iran's nuclear program remained unresolved. Despite the setback, Iran indicated potential for future negotiations, thanking Pakistan for its mediation efforts.
title: Iran hits out at US after Islamabad talks fail, cites ‘breach of promises’

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Playing with the black pieces in Round 11 on Saturday, she claimed a jaw-dropping win over the former World Championship challenger Aleksandra Goryachkina.
title: Candidates Chess: How India's Vaishali trapped Russian's rook to extend lead at top

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Mendis, who was signed by Peshawar Zalmi in the PSL player auction in February for PKR 4.2 crore, was speaking after his team’s 76-run win over Lahore Qalandars in Karachi. The 31-year-old scored 74 off 48 balls and was named Player of the Match.
title: 'Do you regret leaving PSL for IPL?' SL batter put on spot in Pakistan - Watch

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: High-stakes US-Iran talks in Islamabad concluded without a ceasefire or broader diplomatic framework after 21 hours. Key differences, particularly Iran's nuclear program, remain unresolved. Despite the setback, both nations signaled a willingness to continue discussions, with Iran urging the US to drop 'excessive demands' and recognize its rights.
title: Excessive demands vs best offer: What led to Iran-US ceasefire talks collapse

author: CHIDANAND RAJGHATTA
description: High-stakes diplomatic talks between U.S. Vice President J.D. Vance and Iran in Pakistan concluded without an agreement, deepening uncertainty over a Gulf ceasefire. Vance acknowledged the failure, stating Iran rejected Washington's "final and best offer," while Iran cited U.S. unwillingness to recognize its "legitimate rights and interests."
title: The art of no deal: Nuclear mistrust sinks Vance mission

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: London police arrested over 500 individuals during a pro-Palestinian demonstration. The arrests were made for showing support for Palestine Action, a group proscribed in the UK. This action follows a High Court ruling that questioned the ban's legality. Organizers criticized the police action, citing the court's decision. The ban on Palestine Action has led to numerous arrests since its inception.
title: Pro-Palestine rally: Over 500 arrested in London for protesting

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A deadly stampede at Haiti's Citadelle Laferrière on Saturday claimed at least 30 lives as crowds gathered for an annual celebration. Overcrowding and rainfall contributed to the tragedy at the historic fortress, with many young people among the victims. Officials are responding to the scene, and the death toll may increase.
title: Haiti stampede: 30 killed at historic Citadelle Laferrière

author: SUCHITH KIDIYOOR
title: Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat sleeper train gets railways’ nod; full schedule soon

author: VENU LANKA
description: A senior advocate from Hyderabad, B Srinivasa Rao, tragically died when a fly ash tanker overturned onto his car at the Keesara toll plaza. The tanker reportedly lost control due to brake failure, crushing the BMW. Rescue operations were challenging due to the severe impact.
title: Hyderabad advocate killed as tanker overturns on BMW

title: 'Came here in good faith but ... ': JD Vance on why Iran peace talks failed

description: Ranveer Singh's spy drama 'Dhurandhar: The Revenge' has achieved remarkable box office success, nearing Rs 1,070 crore in India net collections. The film experienced a significant surge of over 90% on its 24th day, pushing its worldwide business towards Rs 1,700 crore.
title: ‘Dhurandhar 2’ day 24: Ranveer Singh film nears Rs 1,700 cr

description: Tristan Stubbs (60) kept Delhi Capitals in the chase with a half-century.

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Starlink satellite 34343 experienced an anomaly, leading to a loss of communication. While Starlink cited an "anomaly," space tech firm LeoLabs reported a "fragment creation event" generating multiple objects. This incident mirrors a similar event with Starlink satellite 35956 in 2025, highlighting ongoing space safety concerns.
title: Starlink satellite disappeared at 560 km above Earth; tech co seeks clarity from Musk's company

author: PATHIKRIT CHAKRABORTY
description: A 23-year-old woman died and her mother is in critical condition after a jilted lover allegedly threw acid on them while they slept. The accused, who had a relationship with the victim, reportedly conspired with an associate to carry out the attack after her marriage was fixed elsewhere. Police have arrested two individuals in connection with the incident.
title: 23-year-old UP woman dies after jilted lover throws acid on her

author: ARVIND CHAUHAN
description: Urdu-speaking Assembly constituencies in Uttar Pradesh, many with significant Muslim populations, have shown lower voter deletion rates and slightly higher addition rates compared to the state average. These 46 constituencies saw 26.33 lakh deletions and added 11.79 lakh voters during the recent revision period.
title: ‘Urdu-speaking’ assembly seats in UP record lower voter deletions

author: SURENDRA SINGH
description: US Vice President JD Vance and an Iranian delegation arrived at Pakistan's Nur Khan airbase for peace talks. This base, a key Pakistani military hub, was reportedly targeted by Indian missile strikes last May. The US delegation's choice of the airbase highlights its strategic importance and proximity to Islamabad, despite past damage.
title: Vance-led team lands in Pak’s Nur Khan base, same air hub targeted by India during Op Sindoor

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Sanju Samson ended his early-season slump with a match-winning unbeaten 115 for Chennai Super Kings against Delhi Capitals. His century, coupled with Ayush Mhatre's 59, powered CSK to 212 and secured their first win of IPL 2026. Samson expressed gratitude for the team's trust and support after the crucial performance.
title: '50-second meeting': Samson reveals CSK's turning point after hat-trick of losses

title: Indian man faces abusive calls after video of him dumping trash goes viral

author: KAUSHIK PRADHAN, DEBASHISH KONAR, DWAIPAYAN GHOSH
description: In an unprecedented move, the Election Commission has transferred 59 Kolkata police officers, including joint commissioners and DCPs, following recent political clashes. This marks the ninth mass transfer, bringing the total to 542 officers since March 16. Key positions in crime, headquarters, and intelligence have seen new appointments, aiming to ensure fair conduct during the general election.
title: Bengal polls: In another mass transfer, EC shifts 3 joint CPs, 5 DCPs

author: KSHITIZ
description: In a devastating accident on National Highway-31 in Katihar district, Bihar, a bus and van collided head-on, resulting in the loss of 13 lives and injuring 22 others. The van was transporting members of the tribal community back from Jharkhand when it was hit by a bus driven by an alleged drunk driver.
title: 13 dead as speeding bus collides with van in Bihar's Katihar
